route.conditions: Current Community Open Access policy explicitly excludes author costs and an APC after acceptance; support does not require the submitting author's institution to participate. The journal is online-only. Empirical original articles normally permit 7,000 words, theoretical articles 5,000 and reviews 3,000–6,000, excluding references; longer work needs editorial justification. All submissions require an AI-use statement, including when no AI was used. The current official page says no author cost under Community OA, but its post-acceptance boilerplate still discusses paying an APC where applicable, and an older official PDF says an APC is payable. Submission fees and the apparent inconsistency require confirmation. The current broad no-author-cost Community OA policy supports the route; sponsorship or policy may change.
route.other_mandatory_costs: None for current Community OA under the broad no-author-cost statement; optional third-party permissions or services may cost extra.
